title: In view
hint: Scroll the box, or click it and use the arrow keys. A grey box that is completely visible turns yellow and says so. A box that is cut off at the top or bottom edge stays grey.
tweak: In the JavaScript tab, replace !overflow with !overflow?.includes("bottom"): a box that is cut off only at the top edge then counts as in view.

scenarios.name: at the start the boxes that fit completely are marked
after scrolling the boxes that are cut off at an edge are not marked
